title.value: AN ACT concerning perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in firefighting foam and supplementing Title 56 of the Revised Statutes

value: Sale, manufacture, distribution, or use of class B firefighting foam for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law or regulation (e.g., 14 C.F.R. s.139.317)
If a federal requirement to include PFAS in class B firefighting foam is revoked, the ban applies one year after the revocation
